abilities.name: sand-veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

abilities.name: arena-trap
abilities.effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.  Eluded by flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

abilities.name: sand-force
abilities.effect: Strengthens rock, ground, and steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.

kanto.flavorText: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

original-johto.flavorText: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

hoenn.flavorText: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

updated-johto.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

original-unova.flavorText: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

kalos.flavorText: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.

original-alola.flavorText: Despite the closeness between this Pokémon and farmers and other people, no one has ever seen the parts of it concealed underground.

updated-alola.flavorText: Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.

swsh.flavorText: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.
